description:
Required Technical Skill Set 
 SAP BO design studio dashboard snr developer
  
 Desired Experience Range 
 6+ years in SAP BO
 1-2 Years in BO Design studio
  
 Responsibilities 
  
 Looking for an individual with experience developing data visualizations via SAP’s Design Studio. This candidate would be responsible for gathering and analyzing dashboard requirements and development of Design Studio Dashboards based upon HANA models. In addition, the individual would participate in discussions to validate captured dashboard requirements and develop functional/technical designs.
 Ø Ability to follow the applicable design standards and ensuring that those designs are functionally and technically sound and integrated with other related system components
 Ø Data visualization/dashboard design experience
 Ø Minimum 2 year experience with SAP Design Studio or a minimum of 4 years using another visualization tool
 Ø Experience in building complex dashboards and guide customer team as well;
 Ø Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
 Ø Ability to plan, be detail oriented, and deep problem solving skills
 Ø Ability to gather business requirements and design an SAP support solution
 Ø Understanding of SAP lifecycle development
 Ø Experience with moderately complex SAP solutions with considerable customization beneficial
 Ø Hands-on experience with all aspects of application testing: unit, QA, integration, and performance.
 Ø Ability to draft and execute test plans, and properly validate results.
 Ø Ability to interact well with (and support) business users of the system
 Ø Follow established processes, policies, and procedures for designing, developing, and implementing system solutions.
 Ø Ability to effectively communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization (analyst to vice-president)
 Ø Strong interpersonal and written skills
 Ø IS Retail implementation and support for minimum 1 projects will be added advantage
 Ø Familiarity and knowledge of retail specific processes, and practices will be added advantage
 Relevant SAP Certification will be added advantage
